scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ADMIN-API,ADMIN-UI" -c "magenta,cyan,yellow,green" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:admin:backend" "npm run dev:admin:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix admin/backend && npm install --prefix admin/frontend
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:admin:backend && npm run build:admin:frontend
